wrongContainerCleanup.historicalCleanupNote: Versions 5, 6 and 7 document prior cleanup and are not rollback instructions.
wrongContainerCleanup.mutationScope: The main-site container is outside the grooming project's mutation scope. Never restore, clean, synchronise or publish it during grooming work.
wrongContainerCleanup.publicPayloadReadback: The read-only public payload reported Version 8, the main-site GA4 destination and no grooming measurement ID. Version 8 name, publisher, workspace provenance and differences from historical Versions 5–7 were not investigated and belong to a separately scoped main-site review.

groomingConfiguration: Google tag G-TVNY7185K3 is configured to fire on Initialization - All Pages.
GA4 event enquiry_submitted is configured to fire from the exact custom event enquiry_submitted.
enquiry_submitted is configured as a GA4 key event with no artificial monetary value.
The dedicated GA4 property is linked only to sc-domain:fairytailsdoggrooming.co.uk.
measurementBoundaries: Published GTM configuration does not prove GA4 event receipt.
A configured GA4 key event does not prove that the event occurred.
The site emits enquiry_submitted after a successful webhook HTTP response; this does not prove downstream n8n table or email delivery and is not a completed booking.
Booking starts/completions and telephone/WhatsApp clicks have no implemented or independently verified event attribution in the grooming GTM/GA4 estate.
Consent-denied traffic means analytics totals are not exhaustive.
GSC and Ahrefs visibility do not prove conversion.
completedBookingAttributionDefinitionOfD: For an owner-authorised analytics-consented test booking or an owner-confirmed genuine booking, a real completion event is received by G-TVNY7185K3 and is absent from the main-site GA4 property.
Source, medium and cross-domain session continuity survive the analytics-consented JotForm journey.
For denied consent, no disallowed storage or identifiers are used; any permitted cookieless behaviour is documented separately.
Reconciliation quantifies GA4-measured completions against booking-system records, including consent-denied and otherwise unattributed bookings.
Agents do not submit a production booking, incur payment or modify JotForm merely to test measurement without explicit action-level authority.
repositoryEvidence: GTM-TZWLLT4H and G-TVNY7185K3 are the grooming source-of-truth identifiers.
No completed cross-domain JotForm booking event is evidenced in this repository.
